analytic_consequences.frame_domain: smooth exterior only with positive conformal factor; no transformation across the material wall is used
analytic_consequences.meaning: pulse forces nonzero radius and affine radial-derivative corrections on the initial source leg
analytic_consequences.post_support: h'=-integral(s p'^2)/2<0 and h=-integral((x-s)s p'^2)/2-integral(p^2)/6<0 for the nonzero compact source
analytic_consequences.source_tangent_stress: after support phi=phi_V=0 on U0, so this leg's T_VV=0 and h' stays constant
analytic_consequences.transverse_caveat: chi_U may remain nonzero after source support; T_UU need not vanish; no vacuum or Schwarzschild post-pulse region is inferred
analytic_consequences.unit_scaling: h and h' are dimensionless at fixed geometry. At fixed alpha, delta R scales as ell. At fixed epsilon and G, alpha scales as ell^-2; this changes physical source strength, not merely units.
